description: Client code for testing the git fsmonitor daemon, including functions to send queries, flush cache, and perform load testing with multiple threads.

methods.name: get_token_from_index
methods.description: Reads the last token from the FSMonitor index extension in the git repository index.

methods.name: do_send_query
methods.description: Sends a query to the fsmonitor daemon with a specified token.

methods.name: do_send_flush
methods.description: Sends a flush command to the fsmonitor daemon to clear its cache.

methods.name: hammer_thread_proc
methods.description: Thread procedure to repeatedly send queries to the daemon for load testing.

methods.name: do_hammer
methods.description: Creates multiple threads to send concurrent requests to overload the daemon.

methods.name: cmd__fsmonitor_client
methods.description: Main command function to handle subcommands: query, flush, hammer for the fsmonitor client.
